• Weekend and Bank Holiday enhancements
• 20 Days Annual leave entitlement plus Bank Holidays
• Paid Travel Time
• Mileage Paid at 25 p per Mile
• Employee Referral Scheme
• No Time sheets

About This Job
Most digital design manager roles ask you to maintain what’s already been built. This one asks you to raise it. Williams F1 Team is in the middle of a serious brand evolution, and digital is the primary surface where fans, partners and the wider world experience it. The website, the app, the campaigns around the season’s biggest moments — these are where the brand lives in real time, and right now they have room to be significantly better. You’ll lead the digital creative output, owning the quality and direction of everything we put into the world across our owned digital channels. You’ll sit at the intersection of creative, social and brand — working directly with the Head of Creative, Head of Social and Head of Brand to make sure the digital work is integrated, consistent and genuinely excellent. This is a leadership role that carries real creative accountability, not just a coordination function. If you’re a senior designer ready to step up and run something, or a design manager who wants to do the best work of your career inside a genuinely iconic sport, this is the role.
Lead the Digital Creative
• Own the creative direction and quality bar across all digital outputs — williamsf1.com, the Williams F1 Team app, campaign assets, email, and the digital moments around key race activations.
• Set the standard for how the Williams brand expresses itself digitally, pushing the work to be sharper, more distinctive and more effective over time.
• Lead concept development for the season’s biggest digital moments — race activations, livery reveals, fan campaigns and product launches — from brief through to delivery.
• Oversee and contribute hands on to design work across the team, maintaining quality without becoming a bottleneck.
Integrate Across Creative, Social and Brand
• Work directly and regularly with the Head of Creative, Head of Social and Head of Brand to align digital creative with the broader brand and content strategy.
• Ensure digital outputs are genuinely integrated with social campaigns and brand activity — not treated as a separate stream.
• Act as the connective tissue between teams, spotting where creative could be unified and making it happen.
• Bring a point of view into senior creative conversations — representing the digital channel with authority and advocating for its potential.
Drive Performance and Fan Growth
• Partner with the Fan Growth & Performance team to deliver creative that performs — high quality assets built for paid and organic channels, optimised for reach, engagement and conversion.
• Champion a test and learn culture across digital creative — building systems and templates that allow for rapid iteration without sacrificing craft.
• Use performance data and fan insight to inform creative decisions and push for the next iteration of the work.
• Support the development of scalable creative systems that serve both the always on programme and campaign moments.
Build and Develop the Team
• Manage, mentor and develop the digital design team, creating an environment where craft is taken seriously and people grow.
• Lead briefing, feedback and review processes so the team has clarity and direction without being micromanaged.
• Identify resourcing needs, manage external partners and help shape the structure of the team as the function matures.
• Set a culture of accountability, creative ambition and collaborative working.
Evolve the Digital Design System
• Own the digital component library, design system and motion principles, keeping them current and genuinely useful to the people building with them.
• Work with the Head of Brand to ensure digital outputs are consistent with and actively strengthening the wider visual identity.
• Identify where the brand could be doing more digitally — more confident, more distinctive, more fan facing — and make the case for it.

Qualifications
• 7 or more years of design experience, with a proven track record leading digital creative at a senior level — ideally inside a fast moving consumer, sports or entertainment brand, or a top agency working in that space.
• A strong creative leader with a clear point of view and the credibility to bring others with you — whether that’s a junior designer, a head of social or a senior stakeholder.
• Deeply fluent across the full digital canvas: web, app, campaign, performance creative, brand. You understand how each surface works and what excellent looks like on each one.
• Experienced managing and developing designers, with a genuine interest in building a team and not just doing the work yourself.
• Highly collaborative and comfortable operating at the intersection of multiple creative disciplines — you’ve worked closely with social, brand and marketing leads before and you know how to make integrated creative happen.
• Expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects). You can get in the tools when the work demands it.
• Data informed but creatively led — you understand how to use performance insight to improve the work without letting it flatten it.
• Calm under pressure, decisive when it counts, and genuinely collaborative with the people around you.
• Passionate about Formula 1 — or the kind of person who commits fully to whatever sport or culture they get close to.
• Degree in Graphic Design, Digital Media or a related field preferred; exceptional portfolio over credentials.

About This Job
About the role:
Engineering Experience looks after developer productivity at Wise. We work in two ways. We operate services that engineers rely on every day, and we are the pillar team responsible for improving engineering productivity across Wise.
We are looking for an experienced software engineer who wants to make life better for other engineers. You will build and run tools, help set our technical direction and work directly with teams so the things we create are useful in practice. This is a hands-on role for someone who writes strong production software and is comfortable teaching, advocating and leading change.
How we work:
Everything we build needs to work for more than 1,200 engineers. That scale matters. We are not looking for isolated wins. Saving every engineer an hour has a huge impact, so we focus on common problems and solutions that work across Wise.
We learn by talking to engineers, looking at usage data and seeing how our services behave in production. We use that evidence to design, build and operate improvements that are secure, reliable and easy to use. Adoption is part of the engineering work. We run workshops, write practical guidance and communicate in large engineering forums to help good tools become everyday habits.
We are an AI first team using agentic development tools across the entire SDLC to enhance our productivity and have more impact at Wise. We do not use the tools to replace what we care about, which is people, relationships and working as a team.
What will you be working on?:
•
Owning and operating the agentic tooling used by engineers across Wise, including security, access to models and tools, telemetry and evaluation.
•
Building an engineering knowledge base exposed through a MCP server, so engineers and AI agents can find trusted internal context when they need it.
•
Leading AI enablement across engineering through hands-on workshops, practical guidance and adoption campaigns that help teams use these tools confidently in their day-to-day work.
•
Building and operating products that remove friction across software development, from local setup and code review through to deployment and operation.
•
Improving the developer portal and other shared engineering services so tools, guidance and engineering signals are easy to find and act on.
•
Using research, feedback and data to find problems shared by many teams, then turning them into software and changes that save engineers time across Wise.
What do you need?:
•
A senior engineer comfortable working in a polyglot environment. Our tools and services span languages including Java, Go, Python and TypeScript. You need to be an expert in either Java, Go or TypeScript, but not all of them.
•
Strong experience building and operating production software, including taking services from design through to reliable operation.
•
Excellent software design judgement. You can break down complex problems, define clear boundaries and interfaces, and build systems that are testable, maintainable and observable.
•
Practical experience using agentic tools to deliver real user stories, not only prototypes. You know how to give agents the right context and constraints, review their output and take responsibility for the result.
•
A genuine passion for AI developer tooling and a habit of learning as the field changes. You are interested in how these tools are built, secured, evaluated and adopted.
•
Experience building internal platforms or tooling used by other engineers, with the empathy to treat engineers as your users.
•
Experience leading large technical initiatives across teams and keeping delivery moving when the path is not obvious.
•
Strong code review skills and a high bar for engineering quality, including clear tests and practical feedback that helps other engineers improve.
•
Confidence explaining technical ideas to varied audiences, leading workshops and advocating for change across a large engineering organisation.

About This Job
Digital Senior Data Scientist
AECOM is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science & Analytics team, contributing to transformative data-driven decision-making across global projects. As part of AECOM’s commitment to delivering sustainable and innovative solutions, the Senior Data Scientist will play a critical role in advancing analytics, AI/ML strategies, and IoT-driven insights to unlock measurable business value across infrastructure, environmental, and urban development sectors.
Reporting to the Data Intelligence Lead, this role will focus on designing and implementing predictive and prescriptive models, driving AI/ML strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate data science solutions into AECOM’s operational workflows. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in advanced analytics, machine learning, and IoT technologies, with a passion for solving complex challenges in the built environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Define and execute AI/ML roadmaps aligned with AECOM’s business objectives, including sustainability and operational efficiency.
• Develop and deploy predictive and prescriptive models for key use cases such as demand forecasting, optimisation, and anomaly detection in infrastructure projects.
• Establish best practices for model lifecycle management, including MLOps, monitoring, and retraining, ensuring alignment with AECOM’s global standards.
• Extract actionable insights from complex datasets to inform strategic decisions across infrastructure, environmental, and urban development domains.
• Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and optimisation techniques to solve high-impact business problems, including resource allocation, project risk management, and asset lifecycle forecasting.
• Design and run experiments (e.g., A/B testing, causal inference) to measure the impact of data-driven initiatives on project outcomes.
• Collaborate with data engineering teams to design feature pipelines and ensure data quality across diverse sources, including geospatial, environmental, and operational data.
• Support integration of diverse data sources (batch, streaming, IoT) into unified analytics platforms tailored to AECOM’s global projects.
• Analyse real-time sensor and telematics data to enable predictive maintenance and operational efficiency for connected assets in infrastructure projects.
• Implement anomaly detection and streaming inference solutions to improve asset performance and reduce downtime.
• Mentor junior data scientists and analysts, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence in analytics and modelling.
• Promote best practices in data science and analytics, ensuring alignment with AECOM’s quality standards and project delivery frameworks.
• Present work outputs to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex analytics and AI/ML concepts into clear, layman’s terms.

Qualifications
Minimum Requirements
• 3–5+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning, preferably in infrastructure, environmental, or urban development sectors.
• Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL, with experience in geospatial and environmental data analysis.
• Experience with MLOps tools (MLflow, Docker, CI/CD pipelines) and cloud platforms (Azure preferred), ensuring scalable and reliable solutions.
• Proven ability to influence non-technical stakeholders and communicate complex concepts clearly, especially in the context of infrastructure and environmental projects.
• Experience mentoring and coaching technical teams, promoting collaboration and innovation.
Preferred Qualifications
• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field, with a focus on data science applications in infrastructure or environmental domains.
• Familiarity with time-series forecasting, optimisation, and causal inference, particularly in project planning and resource management.
• Experience with IoT analytics and real-time data processing, including applications in smart cities and connected infrastructure.

About This Job
Turn customer understanding into better decisions
At AJ Bell, understanding our customers is at the heart of how we grow and improve our business.
Working in the D2C business at AJ Bell, the Insights team is a small but dynamic and experienced group of SMEs who work across data, insights and research to ensure customer understanding, market intelligence and data-led analysis are embedded at the heart of how the business sets direction, prioritises investment and measures success.
The Market and Customer Researcher supports the delivery of our customer and market research portfolio, encompassing market research, customer surveys, both tactical and always-on initiatives, and direct customer feedback through interviews and focus groups. The role involves designing and delivering research that builds a strong understanding of our customers, the market and wider consumer trends. Working collaboratively with colleagues across the business, the researcher will help ensure that compelling market, customer and consumer insights inform and support our products, propositions, campaigns and business plans.
What you'll be doing
You'll work across a varied portfolio of market and customer research, combining qualitative and quantitative approaches to answer important business questions.
You'll:
• Undertake end-to-end mixed-method customer and market research projects, incorporating market and desk research, qualitative and quantitative customer and consumer research, and internal data analysis as appropriate.
• Work closely with colleagues in product, marketing and digital, as well as other internal stakeholders, to understand their requirements and develop clear research briefs in response.
• Support the design and delivery of quantitative research and surveys, including questionnaire design, survey coding and build, and results analysis.
• Support the design and delivery of qualitative customer research, including participant recruitment, discussion guide and stimulus development, and conducting group and individual interviews.
• Own competitor tracking and reporting, ensuring that market and competitor alerts and insight packs are delivered to the business in a timely manner with clear implications.
• Undertake desk research using public and third-party data sources to develop an understanding of market trends, consumer behaviour and the competitive landscape.
• Analyse data and distil findings into relevant insights, delivered through clear, compelling and actionable reports that are grounded in consumer truth and commercially relevant.
• Represent the voice of the customer by sharing research findings and insights with internal stakeholders, helping ensure customer and market intelligence informs decision-making.
• Work with agency partners where required to support the delivery of high-quality research that meets stakeholder expectations and represents value for money.
• Support the development of the Voice of Customer capability, including the planning and delivery of always-on customer research and surveys, alongside the evaluation and testing of new data sources and platforms.
• Collaborate with specialist researchers across the business to help translate strategic and customer insights into high-quality delivery across UX, product and customer experience.
• Monitor the quality of research data, agency services and platforms, identifying opportunities for improvement and greater efficiency.
• Engage regularly with internal stakeholders to gather feedback on the quality and impact of research and contribute to a continuous improvement approach that delivers customer and commercial benefit.
What we're looking for
We're looking for someone who is naturally curious and enjoys getting underneath a business question to understand what is really happening.
You'll be able to combine research expertise with commercial thinking, turning evidence into insights that people can understand and act on.
You'll bring:
Research experience
• Experience supporting or delivering multi-stage research projects using qualitative and quantitative approaches
• Practical experience of quantitative research, including questionnaire development, survey build and data analysis
• Experience developing and delivering qualitative research, including participant recruitment, discussion guides, stimulus and interviews
• Experience of customer or consumer research, including always-on or trigger-based research
• Strong market and competitor research experience, including ongoing monitoring, reporting and presenting insights to senior audiences
• Strong desk research skills, using public, third-party and internal customer data
• Experience working with research agencies or external partners
• Good brief-writing skills and the ability to translate stakeholder requirements into appropriate research approaches
Insight and analytical skills
• Strong analytical and logical thinking, with the ability to bring together different sources of data to identify trends, patterns and connections
• The ability to turn research findings into clear, commercially relevant narratives
• An understanding of how customer and market insight can influence product, proposition and digital customer experience
• Good time and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and multiple projects
Knowledge
• A good understanding of market research approaches, including surveys, interviews, focus groups and sampling
• An understanding of customer and consumer needs, motivations, decision-making, journey mapping and research-based segmentation
• Knowledge of statistical and data analysis techniques, including descriptive statistics, with an awareness of regression and multifactorial analysis
• An understanding of qualitative research, including thematic analysis, coding, interpretation and moderation
• An appreciation of research ethics, privacy, data protection and consent management
Skills and approach
• Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex findings accessible to different audiences
• Strong stakeholder engagement skills and a customer-first mindset
• A naturally curious and inquisitive approach, with a willingness to question assumptions and explore different perspectives
• Commercial awareness and an understanding of how customer and market insight can contribute to business value
Experience with customer panels, B2B research, competitor monitoring platforms such as Similarweb, UX platforms such as UserTesting, customer experience platforms such as Qualtrics or Medallia, or CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Salesforce or Bloomreach would be beneficial.

Job Description:

Location: Belfast

36 hours per week // Pension scheme // Success share // Plus many more flexible benefits! // Fridays afternoon off
About us:
Ready to build the wings that lift the world? Join Airbus as a Craft Engineering Apprentice at our site in Belfast and play a vital role in manufacturing the wings and the mid fuselage for our A220 aircraft. This 36-month programme offers valuable hands-on training, recognised qualifications, and a clear path to a rewarding career in aviation.
At Airbus, we believe a diverse workforce drives innovation. We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive. Airbus is a global pioneer in the aerospace industry, leading the way in designing, manufacturing, and delivering aerospace products across Commercial Aircraft, Helicopters, Defence, and Space sectors.
As the global centre of excellence for A220 wing manufacturing and a production hub for the A220 mid fuselage, our Belfast site delivers over 70 wing sets each year.
Our apprenticeship programme is carefully designed to give you valuable practical training alongside your academic studies, setting you up for success and helping your career truly fly.
With over 157,000 employees worldwide and as the largest aeronautics and space company in Europe, Airbus is at the forefront of the aviation industry. During your apprenticeship you will work alongside our experienced fitters and engineers to support you to complete the work safely and efficiently.
What you will be doing:
As a Craft Apprentice you’ll immerse yourself for the first 12 months of the programme learning the foundational skills required for building aircraft. While completing your academic studies the course will also cover an element of mechanical fitting activities.
This programme is designed to equip you with valuable qualifications and competencies to work directly on aircraft components.
This 36-month apprenticeship is structured to maximise your learning and
impact:
Year One: You will spend the first 12 months of your apprenticeship based at the newly renovated Castlereagh Campus of the Belfast Met working towards obtaining:
• NVQ Level 2 Diploma in Performing Engineering Operations;
• Level 2 Academic Qualification;
• Level 2 Essential Skills.
This will allow you to develop the necessary skills, knowledge and experience to enable you to make an immediate contribution when you enter the workforce in the second year.
Year 2 and 3:  Your Learning Takes Flight at Belfast! Building on your foundational knowledge, you'll join our world-class team at the Airbus Belfast site. Here, you'll apply your skills directly to live aircraft projects. Your varied tasks will require a range of technical skills. This will include:
• Preparation & Setup: This involves meticulously cleaning, sanding, and masking surfaces to ensure proper adhesion and a flawless finish. It also includes accurately mixing paints and preparing spray equipment according to specifications.
• Application & Quality: Skillfully applying multiple, even coats of paint using precise techniques, while monitoring environmental conditions. A crucial part of the role is inspecting the finish for quality, making adjustments, and performing touch-ups, all while strictly adhering to safety protocols and equipment maintenance.
• Fitting Activities - This would include a placement in our single aisle and wide body business areas to perform fitting activities in our wing box production areas, these activities will include drilling and installing fasteners.
You'll continue your academic studies on day release, working towards:
• Level 3 NVQ Extended Diploma (Aeronautical Engineering);
• Level 3 Academic Certificate.
Upon successful completion of your 36-month apprenticeship, you'll become a Skilled Fitter, specialising in the assembly of both metallic and composite components to produce the wing box structure and the mid fuselage section of our world-class A220 aircraft.
You'll receive a Modern Apprenticeship Certificate, setting you up for a fantastic career.
Requirements
In order to be eligible to this apprenticeship you must:
Achieve a minimum of four GCSEs which must include:
• Grade C or 4 in Maths
• Grade C or 4 in English Language
• Grade C or 4 in Science or a Technology based subject
• Plus 1 other GCSEs at grade C or 4
Essential Skills, Key Skills or City & Guilds, at the appropriate level, will also be considered as acceptable equivalents
• Attach your CV (stating your predicted or achieved grades) and cover letter stating your motivation for the role and industry.
Applicants should be aware that the selection of successful candidates will be made in accordance with the eligibility criteria for the funding of the Apprenticeships NI 2021 program, as set out by the Department for the Economy.
BOOST YOUR APPLICATION
We want to get to know you! Not just your grades or school background so, tell us on your cover letter:
• Why Airbus?
What is it about Airbus that makes you excited to start a career with us? Is it our aircraft, innovation, global impact, or something else? Let us know what interests you about our work and why we stand out to you.
• Why a hands-on apprenticeship?
Why do you want to learn by doing? We’d love to hear what draws you to practical, skills-based learning.
• Show your hands-on experience.
In your CV or cover letter, include any hands-on activities or hobbies where you've used practical skills. These could be things like:
•
• DIY projects
• Building and fixing things
• Doing make-up or beauty work
• Tinkering and Tech Projects
• Building models
• Baking or cooking
• Others

GRADES:  Any offer will be conditional upon us receiving evidence of your required grades 24h after receiving your certificates on results day, in addition to completing all pre-employment checks and online forms.
SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) check. You may also need to gain UK SC-level Security Clearance or Export Control, depending on the role.
RIGHT TO WORK IN THE UK: Candidates must have current legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom for the full duration of the programme. For more information, please check the Government Website. Our apprenticeship roles do not meet the minimum requirements set by UK Visas & Immigration to enable sponsorship of migrant workers.

A bit about us
Big responsibility. Personal support. That’s Beyond the Ordinary.
Want to get stuck into client work, build your confidence and start shaping your career from day one? Welcome to the Audit Graduate Programme at BDO.
The programme starts on Monday, 20th September 2027, for an organisation-wide induction (you need to be able to attend).
A bit about the Technology Risk Assurance team
Audit at BDO gives you the chance to take on meaningful work early in your career. We’re the only UK mid-market organisation with more than £1bn in turnover and 8,000 people. That means you get the scale and breadth of a major professional services business, while working with clients where your contribution can make a real difference.
We have roles within our Data Analytics and IT controls teams.
What does the TRA controls team do?
The Technology Risk Assurance Controls team helps the audit team identify and assess risks associated with the client's finance applications. We focus on IT systems and processes related to access, change management and automated interfaces between systems. When we identify weaknesses in the client IT environment, we provide recommendations to management to help them strengthen processes and controls. We also work closely with the financial audit team to explain the risks arising from IT that impact our audit approach and may require additional audit testing of financial statement integrity.
Key responsibilities include:
-IT General Controls testing over the financial applications
-Cyber Security Risk Assessments
-Database and Operating Systems controls testing
-Assessment of automated controls operated by the business
What does the TRA Data team do?
The TRA Data team uses data analytics to support audits by examining entire populations of financial data, rather than relying solely on traditional sample-based testing. By combining technology, data analysis and audit expertise, we help provide efficient, high-quality assurance across a range of financial statement areas.
Key responsibilities include:
-Exploring and analysing data to help understand how businesses operate and identify potential risks using tools such as Alteryx, Databricks, Python, SQL, SAS, amongst others
-Checking and validating financial information to support the audit process
-Working closely with colleagues across audit teams to solve problems and deliver successful outcomes
-Presenting insights in a clear and engaging way to help teams focus on key areas of risk, including building visualisations and dashboards
You’ll be trusted with lots of responsibility, but you won’t be expected to figure everything out by yourself. You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues, managers, directors and partners who are there to answer questions, share what they know and help you develop.
It’s a chance to learn by doing, get exposure to clients and build your confidence as your responsibility grows. Big responsibility, with the scale of BDO behind you and personal support around you.
And a bit about the programme
Over three years, you’ll build hands-on experience while working towards recognised professional qualifications including CFAB, ICAEW PowerBI Certification, CISA, and Data Camp courses.
Alongside your studies, you’ll develop your technical and commercial skills through real Audit work. You could gain experience across different clients, sectors and specialist areas, while learning from people across the organisation.
As you develop, so will the responsibility you’re trusted with. Our graduates have talked about joining client calls, leading meetings and working directly with senior colleagues earlier than they expected. You’ll have support around you as you take those next steps and build towards where you want your career to go. When you successfully complete the programme and pass the exams, you’ll be fully qualified as an accountant, and guaranteed a permanent role with us.
As for you
You’re curious, resilient and adaptable. You’re ready to learn, ask questions and take on more responsibility as you grow.
Bring your problem-solving, analytical skills and critical thinking. We’ll give you opportunities to put them into practice, alongside the support to keep developing.
Join us in our London team in either Data or Controls.
One thing to note: you’ll need to live within a commutable distance of the office. Relocation support is not provided, so please consider this carefully before applying. Time together in person matters – whether that’s in the office or with clients. It gives you more opportunities to learn from your team, build relationships and get the most from working together.
Is it for you? To apply, you’ll need:
• A minimum 2:2 degree in any discipline (obtained or predicted)
• Three A-levels (or equivalent) at A*-C (excluding General Studies and Extended Projects), or four Scottish Highers or Advanced Highers at grade A-B (or equivalent, for example BTEC Extended Diploma). Please note: we do not use UCAS points. You’ll be asked to provide evidence if you’re successful in securing an offer
• GCSEs at grade 4 and above in Maths and English, or Scottish National 5 grade A-C. You’ll also need to provide evidence if successful
• Commitment to balance study and professional work
• The right to work in the UK (we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for these roles as they do not meet the current minimum salary requirements for sponsorship set by the Home Office. Applications from candidates who have their own legal right to work within the UK must cover the duration of their 3-year training contract and employment)
How the interview process will go
We want you to know what to expect, so here’s the typical process:
• Online application form.
• Online assessments.
• Video interview.
• Virtual assessment centre.
• Final interview in person.
We’ll keep you updated at each stage and share tips to help you prepare. And just so you know: we don’t use AI in any part of our candidate screening process. Every application is reviewed by a real person.
What you get in return
Our benefits are designed to support your life in and outside of work, with options including additional leave, gym membership and employee discounts, alongside pension, health and wellbeing support and a range of protection benefits.
Salary
£33,000 per annum.
Closing date for applications is Sunday 15th November 2026.
Before you go
Wherever you join BDO, you’ll have the chance to learn by doing, work with clients and build your career with people around you to support your development.
The opportunity to build your experience, confidence and career without having to do it alone.
Big responsibility. Personal support.
That’s Beyond the Ordinary.
Apply now.
Our organisation is distinctive because we preserve and build on the strengths of our culture and the characteristics that make us successful and different. We look for people from all kinds of backgrounds who share these same qualities.

Job Description:
Customer Success Manager - Jonas Event Technology UK
Company Overview
Jonas Event Technology (JET) is a leading provider of event registration software and services, supporting trade exhibitions, consumer shows, and conferences with innovative technology and exceptional customer service. Our mission is to deliver seamless event experiences through powerful SaaS solutions and a client-first approach.
We're the technology behind events. When an organiser runs a trade show, exhibition or conference, we handle the registration - visitors and exhibitors signing up online, badges printed and scanned on the day, check-in at the door, and the lead capture exhibitors use to follow people up afterwards. Our customers are the organisers themselves. Around 70 of them, across roughly 200 events a year, ranging from small conferences to trade shows with tens of thousands of attendees.
We've been doing this for over 30 years, and we're part of Vesta Software Group, which sits under Constellation Software. We're not a pure software business - we combine a registration platform with a full on-site service, with our people and our equipment on the ground on show day. That service is what we're known for, and it's why customers come back year after year.
The role
This is a retention and delivery role, not a sales one. There's no quota and no upsell target - our Account Directors own the commercial relationship.
Your job is to be the organiser's main point of contact, make sure everything they've paid for actually happens, and help them get real value from what we provide.
You'd be joining our Customer Success team, working alongside an established Customer Success Manager. You'd start with our smaller accounts and take on a broader share of the book over your first six to twelve months.
What you'll be doing
•
Taking the registration form brief from an organiser, checking it stacks up, passing it to our digital systems team to build, then making sure it's right before it goes back to the customer
•
Walking customers through the platform and the reporting so they actually use what they're paying for
•
Turning our product and feature updates into something customers understand, then showing them how to use it
•
Keeping proactive contact going - onboarding calls, regular reviews, post-event wash-ups
•
Tracking customer health, spotting when an account goes quiet, and acting on it early
•
Being the customer's voice internally. If something is frustrating several organisers, you're the one who tells our product team
•
Routing work to the right place - commercial conversations to the Account Directors, delivery tasks to the project management team
•
Keeping records accurate in Salesforce and Monday.com
You won't be building registration forms, uploading data or sending campaigns yourself. Those sit with other teams. Your job is making sure it happens, on time and correctly, and that the customer is looked after throughout.
What we're looking for
•
Experience in customer success, account management or client delivery, ideally in software, technology or a service business
•
Comfortable managing a high volume of accounts and deciding where your attention goes
•
Organised and reliable on follow-through. You chase things until they're actually done
•
Able to take something technical and explain it simply to a customer
•
Confident holding an honest conversation when something has gone wrong
•
Happy to be out and about, visiting customers and attending events
•
Comfortable with CRM and project management systems. We use Salesforce and Monday.com, and experience of either is useful but not essential
•
Events industry experience is welcome but not required. We're equally keen to hear from people outside the industry
Why this role
Most of our revenue comes from customers returning year after year, so looking after them well is the whole game rather than a support function bolted on the side. You'd be joining a customer success team early enough to shape how it works.
Practical
•
This is a hybrid role, with time split between working from home and our offices in Wallingford and Birmingham
•
Travel is an expected part of the job. Events take place at venues across the UK and our customers are based nationwide, so visiting customers and attending shows is a regular feature of the role rather than an occasional extra, particularly during the busy periods
•
A full UK driving licence is useful
•
37.5 hours a week

Develop and deliver a risk-based audit report across claim types (e.g., inpatient/day case, outpatient, diagnostics, therapies, mental health, oncology, etc.) aligned to the Trust’s governance priorities and agreed audit scope.

member eligibility and scheme participation at date of service
•
benefit entitlement, limits, cost shares (excess/co-insurance), waiting periods, exclusions, etc.
•
adherence to pre-authorisation/referral requirements and applicable clinical/case management pathways
•
quality of the member experience when corresponding with the claims service and pathways.

Identify, evidence and quantify issues including over/under-payments, duplicate payments, non-covered services, miscoding/upcoding, unbundling, and processing/administrative errors.

Organise disparate information into structured findings, analyse audit outcomes to identify root causes, repeat errors, and control weaknesses; translate these into practical recommendations to improve TPA processing quality.

Produce clear, client-ready audit reports and summaries outlining findings, financial impact, trends, and corrective actions.

Present audit findings and recommendations to Trust/client stakeholders in a confident and professional manner.

Solid experience in PMI claims operations (TPA and/or insurer environment), with exposure to claims decisioning, authorisations and claims assessment; prior claims quality/audit experience preferred.

Proficient in Microsoft tools.

Data gathering: Requesting, obtaining and interpreting insurer information to support case analysis and audit findings

Exposure to high-cost/complex claims and provider billing practices.

Familiarity with audit methodologies (sampling, root cause analysis, control testing).

Claims/insurance qualifications (local equivalent) and/or medical billing/coding familiarity.

Understanding of UK employee benefits, in order to integrate audit findings and recommendations into the client’s wider benefit design.

The Regulatory Affairs Manager leads the application of the regulatory requirements for the Metal Packaging division across EMEA, ensuring that Sonoco products consistently meet stringent Food Contact, Chemical, and Environmental safety standards. Acts as the technical lead for metal packaging, partnering with Sales and Operations to translate complex legislative shifts, such as PPWR and REACH, into practical guidance for the business. Customer Strategy & Brand Protection
• Lead the high-level response strategy for Tier-1 global brand owners. This includes the authoring and validation of complex, customer-specific Declarations of Compliance (DoC) and technical position papers on sensitive regulatory topics.
• Act as the primary technical authority in meetings with major customers, presenting strategic compliance topics and risk assessments to ensure consumer safety and business continuity.
• Provide technical input in customer discussions, explaining regulatory requirements and supporting responses to compliance-related queries.
• Coordinate and support responses to key customer regulatory requirements, including the preparation and review of Declarations of Compliance (DoC) and technical documentation on complex topics.
Regional Supplier Governance & Audit
• Oversee the final regulatory approval of all materials (coatings, inks, compounds) used in Metal Packaging, managing the approval process to ensure documentation is reviewed and complete.
• Participate in the Supplier Quality Audit (SQA) program for regulatory compliance, performing on-site audits and coordinating 3rd-party testing to validate supplier data and mitigate raw material risks.
• Work with suppliers to ensure data transparency, specifically regarding "Trade Secret" formulations and complex substance migration.
Horizon Scanning & Industry Influence
• Represent Sonoco’s interests at the industry level through active leadership in Trade Associations (MPE, JIG).
• Monitor regulatory developments and support engagement with industry groups and trade associations, sharing relevant updates with the business.
• Provide Executive Summaries to senior stakeholders to highlight potential impacts, supporting Sonoco decision-making regarding any exposure and mitigation strategies.
Functional Leadership & Workflow Management
• Provide day-to-day technical guidance for the Food Contact Compliance Analyst, ensuring high-quality output and alignment with EMEA regulatory standards.
• Plan and prioritise the workload for the Food Contact Compliance Analyst function, managing resource allocation to ensure timely delivery of regulatory support to Sales and Operations.
• Provide technical mentorship, ensuring the team maintains up-to-date knowledge of evolving FCM legislation.
• Support the maintenance and effective use of the Regulatory Information Centre (SharePoint), ensuring the standardisation of responses to ensure the business has a "Single Source of Truth" for safety and sustainability data.
Essential:
• Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Food Science, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience managing and prioritising technical workloads, mentoring team members, and providing technical guidance to the department to ensure it meets legal standards.

Desirable

• Experience in overseeing the governance of digital regulatory databases (SharePoint/SMD) or advising on compliance integration within ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
• Knowledge of emerging circular economy regulations (e.g., PPWR) and their impact on metal packaging substrates and recycled content claims.

Are you passionate about helping others and providing exceptional customer service?
If so, then we have the perfect opportunity for you! We are recruiting for a Customer Relationship Consultant to work at our Harrogate & Wetherby Branch
The role of Customer Relationship Consultant includes engaging in conversations to find out our customers’ needs, providing information to them about our full savings range, products, and services that we offer.
You will also engage with our customers through our ‘My Review’ appointments which is a great opportunity to understand and discuss our customers financial goals in a friendly conversation.  By really listening to, and getting to know our customers, you will help them to review their circumstances and what their goals are, whether that be financial, family, retirement, peace of mind or even a new home and through this proactively identify the most appropriate products to suit their needs. All the while providing a straightforward, helpful service that lets your enthusiasm shine through.
Our branches are the heart of our local communities, however increasingly our customers want the flexibility of doing transactions online and engaging with us via our contact centre. In branch we can support our customers face to face, virtually and by outbound contact so we are reaching our customers at relevant times.  So, whether you are promoting a new product or resolving a problem, you will always place our customers’ needs at the heart of everything you do and provide a first-class service every time.
For our customers, you will be more than just the friendly face and voice of Skipton Building Society. You will be a listener, a problem solver and in time a fountain of knowledge to help them achieve their financial goals.
Together, you can help us build a better Society!
Who Are We?
Not just another building society. Not just another job.
We are the fourth biggest building society in the UK and what makes us a bit different is that we're a mutual organisation. We do not have shareholders; we are owned by our members.
We are interested in who you are as a person. Why? Because our membership is made up of many kinds of people and we want our colleagues to be just as diverse.  Our purpose is to help more people have a home, help people save for life ahead and support long term financial wellbeing.
Our colleagues say Skipton Building Society is a great place to work, and you could be one of them. Whatever your background, and whatever your goals, we will help you take the next step towards a better future.
What Will You Be Doing?
• Engaging, understanding and identifying customer needs through asking great questions, listening to customers specific circumstances and tailoring the relevant solution to their needs whilst ensuring the right outcome for the customer and the society.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customers in branch with enthusiasm and a desire to help our customers.
• Conducting ‘My Review’ customer appointments face to face, virtually or by telephone.
• Proactively contacting our customers over the phone to identify and discuss their needs.
• Educate each customer on a range of products and services as well as the different communication channels they can utilise to engage with us directly.
• Use internal systems to ensure that a customer’s records are accurately maintained and are up to date, whilst ensuring vulnerable customers are identified and supported appropriately.
• Adhere to and understand the appropriate policies, standards, controls and limits of authority applicable to your role, supported by training, coaching and appropriate communication.
What Do We Need From You?
• You will have previous experience of interacting with customers. We’re happy to ‘think outside the box’ of wanting people who have previously worked in a bank or building society before.
Your experience working with customers may be in person or over the phone, either is fine as Skipton’s customers are increasingly looking for flexible ways of engaging with us so your experience in a Contact Centre environment may be just what we’re looking for.
Your experience may be in retail, food & beverage, guests services or even the health/care sector. Whatever your background, if you can demonstrate a passion for delivering exceptional service and going above and beyond we’re happy to consider you.
• You will enjoy meeting new people and engaging in purposeful conversation.
• The ability to work well alongside others, with a ‘one-team’ mindset.
• The ability to react fast when the day gets busy and handle a wide variety of different customers with excellent time management.
• The desire and ability to grow, adapt and change whilst accommodating business needs and priorities.
• You will be an effective communicators with the ability to influence different audiences using suitable channels for achieving clear outcomes.
• That you are open to a broad range of activities even if outside of standard expectations
What Is In It For You?
The role of Customer Relationship Consultant will be a 12 month fixed term contract position working 36 hours per week.
The salary is up to £27,000 per annum plus a range of benefits which includes:
• Annual discretionary bonus scheme.
• 25 days standard annual leave + bank holidays and rising 1 day per year of service to a maximum of 30 days after 5 years.
• Holiday trading scheme allowing the ability to buy and sell additional annual leave days.
• Generous employer matched pension contributions – up to 10% per annum.

• Private medical insurance for all our colleagues.
• Salary Sacrifice Scheme for hybrid/electric car.

Job Description
Overview
Shape the future of regulatory monitoring in the water industry.
The water industry is facing increasing scrutiny and investment in environmental performance, wastewater monitoring and regulatory compliance. Reliable reporting depends not only on data, but on the instrumentation, operational practices and management systems behind it.
We are looking for a Regulatory Monitoring Consultant to join our Asset and Information Management practice and help grow our specialist capability.
Working alongside our Technical Authority for Regulatory Monitoring and Compliance and a wider multidisciplinary team, you will help water companies manage monitoring risk from sensor to submission and beyond.
This role brings together three core areas: wastewater industry knowledge, instrumentation and monitoring, and data analysis and you do not need to arrive as a complete regulatory-monitoring specialist.
Your role
Your work will vary across client assignments and may include:
• Analysing wastewater flow, spill, process and instrumentation data to identify anomalies, trends and potential compliance risks.
• Supporting flow-compliance investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective-action planning.
• Reviewing the selection, installation, calibration, operation and maintenance of monitoring instrumentation.
• Assessing whether monitoring arrangements and available data are fit for their intended operational and regulatory purpose.
• Supporting the development and assessment of instrumentation, quality or environmental management systems.
• Contributing to technical audits, assurance reviews and regulatory submissions.
• Supporting sensor strategies, monitoring asset plans, technical standards and investment programmes.
• Presenting clear, evidence-based findings to operational, technical and senior client stakeholders.
• Contributing to methods, guidance, training and the continued growth of our Regulatory Monitoring and Compliance capability.
• The role combines detailed technical investigation with a wider management-system perspective.
• You could move between reviewing an individual monitoring installation, analysing operational data and helping a client improve its governance, assurance or investment approach.

Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?

Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
Our Industrial Placement Programme
Our Industrial Placement Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside industry leaders, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You will support the design and development of our world leading electro-optical, communications and information system products under the guidance of experienced Electronics Engineering Leads.
You will be introduced to utilising state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools to explore all aspects of the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, test, acceptance and product support.

Qualifications

For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.

Role overview
IQVIA UK Consulting already supports clients across most of the promotional value chain — targeting and segmentation, campaign implementation through our Direct Medical Engagement (DME) teams, and impact measurement. However, we currently have no in-house offer for the strategic front-end of promotion: marketing strategy, channel/media planning and media buying advisory.
We are hiring an experienced Marketing Strategy & Media Planning expert to build this capability from the ground up. The role will design and sell the proposition, deliver the first engagements personally, and progressively use our existing Consulting bench as the delivery engine — with the right support, guidance and quality assurance. This is an entrepreneurial, P&L-aware role: part practice builder, part senior client advisor.
Key responsibilities
•
Capability build. Define and stand up IQVIA UK's marketing strategy & media planning offer: service design, methodologies, pricing, IP/templates, quality standards and go-to-market narrative. Codify ways of working so the offer scales beyond the founder.
•
End-to-end promotional strategy. Lead client engagements covering brand and portfolio strategy, positioning, messaging architecture, customer journey, channel mix, campaign planning, and KPI/measurement frameworks — linking strategy to IQVIA's existing targeting, DME execution and PromoSuite measurement assets.
•
Media planning & buying advisory. Advise clients on channel strategy across HCP and (where relevant) patient/consumer audiences. Run channel selection, budget allocation, flighting and media-mix recommendations. Manage relationships with media agencies/owners and oversee buying where executed via partners.
•
Sales & business development. Own a personal sales target. Generate and convert pipeline through existing IQVIA accounts and your own network. Lead proposals, pitches and commercial negotiations; cross-sell into Consulting, DME, OneKey, Real-World and Technology offerings. The role would be supported by sales specialists who will also drive client discussions.
•
Client leadership. Act as the senior strategic advisor for clients (Marketing Directors, Brand Leads, Heads of Omnichannel, Commercial Excellence). Build trusted, repeat-buyer relationships.
•
Delivery oversight. Use Consulting analysts/consultants/managers as the delivery engine. Scope, staff, QA and commercially manage projects; coach the team on marketing/media craft they don't yet have.
•
Partnerships. Identify and manage a curated bench of creative, media and production partners (either through internal IQVIA teams or boutique agencies)
•
Compliance & governance. Ensure all work is delivered in line with ABPI, PMCPA, MHRA, BHBIA and applicable advertising codes (CAP/BCAP, ASA) and IQVIA's own compliance and data-use standards.
•
Thought leadership. Represent IQVIA externally — POVs, conference speaking, client roundtables — to position the new capability in the UK market.
Essential experience & skills:
•
15+ years' experience in a marketing strategy and/or media planning role within a healthcare and/or FMCG agency, consultancy or in-house brand team (agency-side experience strongly preferred).
•
Demonstrable ownership of end-to-end promotional strategy — from insight and positioning through to channel plan, execution brief and measurement.
•
Hands-on experience of media planning, with working knowledge of media buying processes, agency economics and the main UK media owners/platforms (HCP and consumer).
•
Proven sales track record: personal book of business, owning revenue targets, closing six- and seven-figure engagements.
•
Established senior client network in UK pharma/healthcare (Marketing, Omnichannel, Commercial Excellence) and/or FMCG.
•
Strong commercial acumen: scoping, pricing, margin management, contracting.
•
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to flex between C-suite, brand teams and delivery analysts.
•
Comfortable building from a blank sheet — entrepreneurial, pragmatic, hands-on.
Desirable / additional skills:
•
Omnichannel / orchestration expertise — designing HCP customer journeys across rep, email, digital, congress, paid media and content syndication; familiarity with platforms such as Veeva, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Experience Cloud.
•
Performance marketing & analytics literacy — media mix modelling, attribution, A/B testing, working knowledge of GA4, programmatic, DSPs and retargeting frameworks.
•
Data-driven mindset — comfortable using IQVIA assets (sales data, PromoSuite, OneKey, ALHP/Synmetrics) to shape strategy and prove ROI.
•
Creative judgement — able to brief and challenge creative agencies on concept, messaging and production quality (without being a creative themselves).
•
Regulatory fluency — ABPI Code, PMCPA, MHRA promotional rules; awareness of EFPIA and equivalent EU codes is a plus.
•
International exposure — experience working across EU markets or with global brand teams; awareness of how UK promo strategy fits into pan-European plans.
•
Therapy-area depth — at least one of: oncology, immunology, rare disease, vaccines, cardiometabolic, CNS.
•
Consulting hygiene — structured problem solving, project economics, ability to QA junior deliverables, comfort with MSAs/SOWs.
•
People leadership — track record of building and mentoring small teams; ability to attract talent into the new capability over time.
•
Awareness of adjacent IQVIA offerings (Real-World Evidence, Technology, Patient Solutions) to spot cross-sell opportunities.
Why this role is different
•
You are not joining an existing practice — you are building one, with senior sponsorship and a pre-existing client base.
•
You sit at the intersection of strategy, data and execution: IQVIA owns the targeting, the execution arm (DME) and the measurement — you bring the strategic glue.
•
Clear precedent in other IQVIA markets — proven model, UK is the next logical market.
IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. Join us as a Lead Analyst, Legal Entity Capital Modelling and Production, to take your career to the next level with a global market leader.
How you will create an impact
Reporting to the Head of Legal Entity Capital Modeling and Production, you will support the production processes across Global Risk and the Capital Modeling and Analytics team including the Group Capital Model, two Solvency II approved Internal Models for both UK and Europe, other local legal entity models and support to Talbot models as appropriate.
The Legal Entity capital models for UK and Europe are used in assessment of Capital Adequacy, Portfolio Management, Risk Management, Asset Management and Reinsurance Management and have approval under Solvency II from their respective regulators.  In addition, the team maintains other legal entity capital models, currently Canada and Bermuda models, which support local legal entity risk management and Own Risk and Solvency reporting (ORSA) requirements.
Production processes consist of supporting regular updates of all models, including collection of inputs, quality assurance, implementing controls and validation tests, production of results, analysis of change and assisting with presentations.   Furthermore, production includes review and optimization of processes via the creation of new tools and automation as required.
Some of the key responsibilities include:
• Produce and present model output and changes for key projects to business stakeholders.
• Support business partners with use requirements:
• Risk Officers with updates to Risk Reporting, Risk Appetite monitoring, Stress Testing, ORSA
• Capital Management for Overall Capital Assessments
• Reinsurance Officers for Reinsurance Adequacy
• Market Risk Officers for analytics on the Investment Portfolio
• Support the production of quarterly Internal Model baselines for Group, UK, Europe, Canada and Bermuda legal entities for presentation committees or regulators as appropriate.
• Support initiatives to integrate production processes across AIG’s Capital Models (including Group and Talbot where appropriate) to achieve a unified annual run calendar, and common working practices and quality assurance leading to greater resilience.
• Keep both the Internal Model and Standard Formula up to date with Regulatory Changes, changes in the company’s risk profile and changes in external environment.
• Update logs, reports, testing and documentation such as the Technical Issues log, Expert Judgement Log, Sensitivity Testing Report and Model documentation.
What you'll need to succeed
• MSc in a quantitative field, Qualified Actuary or equivalent

The candidate must lead and assist in the design and programming of new projects. The Sr. Controls Engineer is responsible for supporting other members of the FORTNA controls group to ensure accurate documentation, proper system functionality, adherence to approved design and customer specifications.

• Write and implement modular and reuseable PLC code and assist in all on-site controls engineering tasks.
• Design and develop “Human Machine Interface” (HMI) using commercially available products such as Ignition.
• Implement PLC and HMI programs to satisfy current design and customer specifications.
• Work with FORTNA employees, customer representatives and third-party vendors to ensure all aspects of a project are considered during both the design and execution phases
• Review electrical designs and provide accurate as-built drawings for approval.

• Provide support of system commissioning efforts as required.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or comparable.
• 4-7 years of experience within an industrial controls environment which includes:
• PLC programming (Siemens TIA Portal, Beckhoff TwinCAT, LD, ST, SCL)
• HMI Programming (Ignition SCADA, Siemens Unified Comfort)
• Input and output device design, implementation, and troubleshooting.
• Industrial communication networks (EtherNet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, etc.)
• Low voltage electrical design and drawing understanding and creation.
• Equivalent work experience will also be considered as a substitute for education.
• Experience with VFDs preferred (networked a plus).
• Experience with Microsoft 365 - Office Apps.
SKILLS/ABILITIES:
• Must be self-motivated, self-aware, detail-oriented, and results-focused.
• Understanding of VFDs, induction motors, programmable logic controllers and industrial networks.
• Demonstrates understanding of project management, service management, or relationship management principles.
• Abilities and knowledge in practices and techniques gained through experience and exposure to complex and diverse techniques, theories, and principles.
• Ability to troubleshoot and isolate controls I/O problems
• Schedule, manage, and execute basic system implementations, enhancements, and retrofits.
• Collaborate and communicate with FORTNA team members, project managers and customers in a professional written and spoken manner.
• Provide direction and leadership to Jr. level controls engineers and contractors.
WORK ENVIRONMENT:
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, etc.
When traveling the job environment shifts to a site-based, typically industrial. When traveling this role routinely uses appropriate PPE, electrical diagnostic tools, electrical implementation tools, laptops, and networking equipment.
TRAVEL: This position requires up to 70-80% travel to various sites.

• Ability to navigate safely over and around warehouse automation equipment

Kainos is recognised as one of the UK’s leading AI and data businesses, with a decade-long track record of delivering impactful, production-grade AI solutions for clients across government, healthcare, defence, and commercial sectors. As a Senior AI Engineer at Kainos, you will deliver advanced AI solutions leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning, generative and agentic AI technologies. • Strong interpersonal skills and team working.
• Active SC Clearance.
DESIRABLE:

• Experience with data storage for AI, vector databases, semantic search, and knowledge graphs.

• Familiarity with AI security, privacy, and compliance standards e.g. ISO42001.

Job overview
As Director, Epidemiology, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and a senior methodological leader within Fortrea Consulting. You will lead complex epidemiology and real-world evidence engagements, providing scientific oversight across study design, methodology, analysis, interpretation, and communication of findings.
You will work closely with pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients to address critical evidence-generation needs, support regulatory and payer decision-making, and deliver scientifically robust solutions that create meaningful impact across healthcare.
In addition to client delivery, you will play a key role in business development, thought leadership, innovation, and the continued growth of Fortrea's epidemiology practice.
What You Will Do
Scientific Leadership & Client Advisory
• Provide senior scientific and methodological leadership across observational, non-interventional, and real-world evidence studies.
• Advise clients on evidence-generation strategies that support clinical development, regulatory submissions, market access, and health technology assessment requirements.
• Lead the design and oversight of complex epidemiologic and real-world evidence research programs.
• Ensure scientific rigor, methodological excellence, and regulatory relevance across client deliverables.
• Communicate complex scientific concepts and study findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, including regulatory, payer, and executive stakeholders.
Client Delivery & Strategic Consulting
• Lead client engagements and act as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle.
• Deliver strategic epidemiology, pharmacoepidemiology, and real-world evidence expertise across a broad range of consulting assignments.
• Manage multidisciplinary project teams to ensure successful delivery of high-quality solutions.
• Provide expert guidance on study design, data strategy, and analytical approaches to address client business and scientific objectives.
• Drive quality, innovation, and excellence across all client-facing activities.
Business Development & Practice Growth
• Contribute to the identification, pursuit, and successful delivery of new business opportunities.
• Develop and strengthen long-term client relationships through exceptional scientific leadership and service delivery.
• Lead the epidemiology component of proposals, study scoping, budgeting activities, bid defenses, and capability presentations.
• Support the continued growth and market positioning of Fortrea Consulting through thought leadership and industry engagement.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
• Advance Fortrea's epidemiology and real-world evidence capabilities through innovation and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Author and contribute to scientific publications, white papers, conference presentations, and industry thought leadership activities.
• Help define best practices that strengthen methodological excellence, scientific credibility, and evidence-generation standards across the organization.
People Leadership
• Mentor, coach, and develop epidemiologists and multidisciplinary consulting professionals.
• Support talent development, succession planning, and recruitment activities.
• Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.
• Lead project teams and provide performance guidance and professional development support.
What We Are Looking For
• Doctoral-level degree in Epidemiology, Pharmacoepidemiology, Public Health, or a related quantitative health science discipline.
• Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of educational requirements.
• Demonstrated scientific leadership and technical expertise in epidemiology applied to non-interventional and real-world evidence research.
• Proven success leading client engagements and managing multidisciplinary project teams.
• Experience developing and maintaining strong client relationships.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Collaborative leadership style with the ability to work effectively across disciplines and global teams.
Required Experience
• A minimum of 10 years of experience applying epidemiological methods within consulting, CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, academic, or related environments, including significant non-interventional research experience.
• Doctoral-level candidates with at least 8 years of relevant experience will also be considered.
• Minimum 6 years of experience leading teams, mentoring staff, and managing complex projects.
Preferred Qualifications
• PhD, DrPH, PharmD, MD, or equivalent advanced scientific qualification.
• Deep expertise in real-world evidence, observational research, and applied epidemiology.
• Solid understanding of secondary real-world data sources (eg, claims, CPRD/NHS, EHR, registries)
• Experience with external control arms/synthetic controls, natural history studies, and HEOR deliverables (eg, comparative-effectiveness studies, payer evidence, indirect treatment comparisons)
• Experience supporting evidence generation for regulatory, reimbursement, and health technology assessment purposes.
• Strong business development, consulting, and problem-solving capabilities.
• Experience working within multidisciplinary environments spanning epidemiology, market access, biostatistics, healthcare analytics, and health economics.
• Ability to influence strategic decision-making and develop innovative client solutions.
Why Join Fortrea?
At Fortrea, you will have the opportunity to shape evidence-generation strategies for leading life sciences organizations while working alongside some of the industry's most respected scientific and consulting professionals.
You will join a collaborative team committed to scientific excellence, innovation, and delivering meaningful impact for clients and patients worldwide.
Apply Today
If you are a recognized epidemiology leader seeking an opportunity to drive scientific excellence, influence strategic decision-making, and help shape the future of real-world evidence, we invite you to join Fortrea.

We are seeking an experienced Front-End Developer to join the Literature Services team at the European Bioinformatics Institute (EMBL-EBI), based at the Wellcome Genome Campus near Cambridge, UK.
About the Team
The Literature Services team develops and operates Europe PMC, a major open research infrastructure providing access to biomedical and life sciences literature. Europe PMC contains over 47 million publications, including more than 12 million full-text articles, and connects the scientific literature with research data, grants, citations, persistent identifiers and text-mined biological information. The service supports millions of users and large-scale programmatic access to the scientific literature.
What you will do
You will have a key role in developing the user-facing Europe PMC service, creating fast, accessible and intuitive interfaces that enable researchers to search, navigate and understand a large and increasingly interconnected scientific literature corpus.
Working closely with UX and product colleagues, back-end developers, data scientists and other members of the Literature Services team, you will translate user needs and designs into robust, reusable and maintainable front-end applications and components.
You will contribute to the ongoing evolution of Europe PMC's web architecture, helping us improve performance, accessibility, maintainability.
Your key responsibilities will include:
• Designing, developing and maintaining responsive, accessible and high-quality web interfaces for Europe PMC.
• Building reusable front-end components and contribute to a consistent design system across the service.
• Translating UX designs, prototypes and user requirements into production-quality interfaces.
• Developing interfaces for complex, data-rich functionality including literature search, filtering, article pages and research workflows.
• Integrating front-end applications with APIs and other web services using structured data such as JSON.
• Optimising front-end performance, including page loading, rendering and efficient delivery of web assets.
• Developing automated tests and contributing to continuous integration and deployment practices.
• Ensuring interfaces meet appropriate accessibility, usability and web standards.
• Working collaboratively with software developers, UX/product specialists, data scientists and scientific colleagues as part of cross functional teams
• Participating in code review, technical design and architectural discussions.
• Contributing to Agile development processes and the continuous improvement of Europe PMC.
You will have:
• Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript and modern web development standards.
• Experience developing responsive, cross-browser web applications using a modern front-end framework such as React, Vue or equivalent.
• Experience building reusable components and maintainable front-end architectures.
• Experience integrating web applications with REST APIs and working with structured data such as JSON.
• A good understanding of web performance and experience diagnosing and improving front-end performance.
• Experience with automated testing and modern front-end testing frameworks.
• Experience using source control, particularly Git, and collaborative software development practices.
• Good understanding of web accessibility, usability and responsive design.
• An understanding of interaction and visual design, with the ability to work effectively with UX specialists and translate designs into high-quality interfaces.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively with complex requirements and large, data-driven applications.
• Fluency with AI-assisted coding and development tools as part of standard working practice
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

• Developing high-traffic or large-scale public web services.
• Design systems and component libraries.
• Front-end performance monitoring and optimisation.
• Search and discovery interfaces or other complex data-intensive applications.
• Agile development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
• Bioinformatics, scientific information services, scholarly publishing or open research infrastructure.
Working Pattern: This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, with 1-2 days per week on site, including one designated team day to support collaboration and connection.
Contract length: Grant-funded, 3-year fixed-term Staff Member contract.
Salary: Grade 5 - Monthly salary from £3,452.05 after tax, plus generous benefits and financial allowances based on individual circumstances. Excluding 12.99% personal pension and insurance contributions.
